show_widget_gauges.title: Show Widget Gauges
show_widget_gauges.description: Show flow/margin gauges inside the pump-curve widget. Testing aid — production installs use the native gauge variables instead.

flow_display_units.title: Flow Display Units
flow_display_units.description: Units flow is displayed in (UI and widget). Internal maths and the curve stay in m3/h.

bep_flow_m3h.title: BEP Flow (m3/h)
bep_flow_m3h.description: Best-efficiency-point flow at the curve reference speed, from the manufacturer. Enables the efficient-zone shading and % of BEP output.

pump_curve.title: Pump Curve
pump_curve.description: Manufacturer head-flow(-NPSHr) points at the reference speed. Digitise from the datasheet.

npshr_m.title: NPSHr (m)
npshr_m.description: Net positive suction head required, from the manufacturer's curve. Optional per point.

curve_reference_speed_rpm.title: Curve Reference Speed (RPM)
curve_reference_speed_rpm.description: Pump speed the curve points were published at.

site_elevation_m.title: Site Elevation (m)
site_elevation_m.description: Metres above sea level; sets barometric pressure for NPSHa.

gauge_separation_m.title: Gauge Separation (m)
gauge_separation_m.description: Discharge gauge height minus suction gauge height.

suction_gauge_height_above_impeller_m.title: Suction Gauge Height Above Impeller (m)
suction_gauge_height_above_impeller_m.description: Height of the suction tapping above the impeller eye (negative if below).

minimum_running_speed_rpm.title: Minimum Running Speed (RPM)
minimum_running_speed_rpm.description: Below this pump speed the pump is treated as not running.

start_inhibit_seconds.title: Start Inhibit (Seconds)
start_inhibit_seconds.description: Alerts and trips are suppressed for this long after the pump starts (priming).

npsh_warning_margin_m.title: NPSH Warning Margin (m)
npsh_warning_margin_m.description: NPSHa - NPSHr below this raises the marginal alert.

npsh_danger_margin_m.title: NPSH Danger Margin (m)
npsh_danger_margin_m.description: NPSHa - NPSHr below this is the danger/trip condition.

alert_debounce_seconds.title: Alert Debounce (Seconds)
alert_debounce_seconds.description: A condition must persist this long before an alert is sent.

trip_debounce_seconds.title: Trip Debounce (Seconds)
trip_debounce_seconds.description: DANGER must persist this long before the trip action fires.

trip_action.title: Trip Action
trip_action.description: NONE = alert only (commissioning default). Arm per pump only after thresholds are proven on site.

trip_tag.title: Trip Tag
trip_tag.description: For SET_TAG: the tag to write (e.g. an engine controller stop command).
